data.value: How {0} handles your data and cookies, and what your rights are.

data.name: PrivacyIntro
data.value: {0} handles your data with care. Here you can read which data we keep, why, and what your rights are.

data.name: PrivacyReservationText
data.value: When you make a reservation, we ask for your name, email address, phone number, address and any notes. We only use them to carry out your reservation: to confirm it, to deliver or arrange the pickup and to contact you about your reservation. We only share them with the service providers we need for this, such as for sending emails, and never for their own purposes. We do not keep them longer than necessary, or as long as the law requires.

data.name: PrivacyCartText
data.value: What you put in your cart is stored on our server. Your browser only holds a functional cookie with a random key, so we can find your cart again. In the first step of a reservation, we ask for your email address. If you tick that you want a reminder, we send you one email if you have not finished your reservation a day later. A cart that has not been changed or reserved for 7 days is deleted, together with your email address, unless you asked for news and offers.

data.name: PrivacyMarketingText
data.value: If you tick during your reservation that you want to receive news and offers from {0}, we keep your email address, your language and when you gave that consent, even after your cart is deleted. We only use that address to send you news and offers from {0}. If you no longer want this, let us know and we will delete your address.

data.name: PrivacyCookiesText
data.value: This website uses cookies that it needs to work, for example to send the reservation form securely and to remember your choice about statistics. They do not require consent.

data.name: PrivacyAnalyticsText
data.value: With your consent, we use Google Analytics to see how visitors use the website, for example which items are popular and how many reservations come in through the website. Google places cookies for this and processes your IP address and data about your device and your visit. We never send your name, email address or other contact details to Google. Without your consent, we do not load Google Analytics. We keep your choice for six months; you can always change it via ‘Cookie settings’ at the bottom of every page.

data.name: PrivacyRightsText
data.value: You can always view, correct or have your data deleted, and object to its use. To do so, get in touch with us:

data.name: PrivacyComplaint
data.value: If you are not happy with how we handle your data, you can file a complaint with the Belgian Data Protection Authority (dataprotectionauthority.be).

data.name: ConsentText
data.value: May we use Google Analytics to see how you use this website? It helps us improve it. We never pass on your name or contact details.
